intended_object: The canonical equivalence between the dependent sum Σ i, PLift (P i) and the subtype {i // P i}, sending ⟨i, ⟨h⟩⟩ to ⟨i, h⟩. This comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body composes three equivalences: psigmaEquivSigma (used backwards), psigmaCongrRight with Equiv.plift, and psigmaEquivSubtype. Each is the obvious structure-preserving map, so the composite is the canonical bijection. The hypothesis α : Type v is forced, because Sigma needs its index type to be in Type. The version over a general Sort is the separate lemma psigmaEquivSubtype, which uses PSigma; this definition is its Sigma/PLift variant, stated at the generality where it makes sense.
